app.name: JobAgent
app.tagline: Verifiable ability profiles from code hosting platform behavioral evidence
home.title: Enter a username to generate a verifiable ability profile
home.subtitle: Analyzes public commits, PRs, issues and other behavioral traces to produce an evidence-backed report
home.step1.title: Collect behavioral traces
home.step1.desc: Only public L0 metadata and L1 behavioral sequences; repositories are never cloned
home.step2.title: Rule-based analysis
home.step2.desc: Pure-function engine computes authenticity, skill tags and interview questions; versioned and reproducible
home.step3.title: Produce a trusted report
home.step3.desc: Every conclusion is backed by evidence that links back to the original platform record
job.stillQueued.title: Your job is still queued — nothing was dropped
job.stillQueued.body: This deployment drains the analysis queue with a scheduled poll (planned hourly, but in practice often delayed by several hours). You can close this page; resubmitting the same username later returns to this very job, and the share link opens as soon as the report is ready. If it has not finished after a day, the drain itself is broken — report it with the job ID below.
report.title: Ability Profile
account.declareConfirm:
After declaring, you can browse candidate profiles and interview data here. Your account will not become visible to candidates.

Candidates are not notified when their profiles are viewed. You can revoke the declaration anytime from the account menu (revoking does not delete interview records you created). For disputes, contact {email}.

Declare recruiter status now?
account.revokeConfirm:
After revoking, you will lose access to the candidate search and recruiter interview data.

Revoking does not delete interview schedules you already created; declare again to regain access. For disputes, contact {email}.

Revoke now?
account.recruiterActionFailed: Action failed, please try again later.
report.unclaimedBadgeTitle: The subject has not signed in to claim this profile, so identity is not owner-verified; conclusions are inferred from public activity data
report.unclaimedNotice: This profile was generated automatically from public activity data and has not been authorised or claimed by its owner. Every conclusion is a reviewable aid, not a finding of fact; use the channel below to request a correction or deletion.
report.claim.error: Could not claim this profile; please try again
report.claim.hint: Claim when your signed-in account matches this profile's subject; it marks the report as owner-verified
report.unclaim.error: Could not unclaim this profile; please try again
report.unclaim.hint: Unclaiming keeps the profile, evidence and applications, but the report returns to public read-only and the application tracker becomes visible to everyone; you can re-claim anytime
report.unclaim.confirm:
After unclaiming, this report returns to public read-only and the application tracker is visible to any visitor.

The profile, evidence, applications and interview records are not deleted, and you can re-claim anytime.

Unclaim now?
report.removal.notice: A removal request for this profile is pending review; it will not be publicly distributed until the review is complete.
report.removal.submitted: Removal request received; we will process it after review. While pending, this profile will not be publicly distributed.
report.removal.contactPlaceholder: Contact (optional, so we can reach you)
report.removal.hint: If you are the data subject of this profile and cannot sign in to claim it, you can file a removal request here. After filing, the profile enters a pending state and is deleted once an operator reviews and approves it. We only keep the request for review and will not publish your contact.
report.fusion.badgeTitle: Built from both GitHub and Gitee, with mirror repos and cross-posted threads automatically deduped
report.dispute.subject: Report dispute
report.dispute.body: If you believe a conclusion is wrong or evidence is inaccurate, email us the details and we will review and correct it.

report.summary.headline: Headline
report.verifiability.banner: Every conclusion is tied to verifiable public behavior evidence — not self-reported claims.

report.resume.error: Could not build the resume. Please try again.
report.resume.localPrivacy: Saved only in this browser, never uploaded, and used solely to render this resume.
report.resume.polishHint: Only improves phrasing; it never adds experience, skills or numbers. Falls back to the rule-based version when no model is configured or validation fails.

report.resume.polishReasonValidationFail: The polished output failed safety validation; fell back
report.resume.polishReasonFabricationDet: The polish may have added content; fell back to the rule-based version
report.resume.coverLetterHint: A cover letter drafted from your resume and the target job, using only facts already present in both. Review before use.
report.resume.coverLetterNotConfigured: No model configured on the server (LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED)
report.resume.coverLetterAuthRequired: Sign in required (cover letters are a paid capability for signed-in users)

applications.title: Application tracker
applications.hint: Track your applications and progress per role. Records are tied to this profile and stored in your account database.
applications.empty: No applications yet. Add your first one.
interviews.title: My interviews
interviews.hint: Schedule interviews from your applications, track rounds and record outcomes. Visible only to you.
interviews.empty: No interviews yet. Schedule the first one from an application.
interviews.required: Role, start/end time and round are required, and end must be after start.
interviews.loginRequiredTitle: Sign in to manage my interviews
interviews.loginRequiredBody: Managing interviews, moving their status and recording outcomes requires a signed-in account. Interview data is visible only to you.
recruit.title: Candidate search
recruit.subtitle: Search generated, evidence-backed profiles by skills, authenticity and confidence. Every claim links back to public behavioral evidence.
recruit.gate.title: Declare recruiter status to access the talent pool
recruit.gate.body: The candidate search and recruiter interview tools are available only to users who explicitly declare recruiter status. Declaration has no approval step and can be revoked anytime.
recruit.gate.self: After declaring, you can view candidate profiles and interview data here; your account will not become visible to candidates.
recruit.gate.candidate: Candidates are not notified when recruiters view their profiles. You can revoke the declaration anytime; revoking does not delete interview records you created.
recruit.gate.login: Sign in, then declare recruiter status
recruit.gate.consent: I have read and understood the consequences above and confirm my recruiter declaration.
recruit.gate.failed: Declaration failed. Please try again, or sign in first.
recruit.empty: No candidates match these filters. Try widening them.
recruit.shortlistTitle: Shortlisted candidates ({count}, saved on this device)
home.notFoundNotice: No profile found for this account. Check the username and try again.

report.partialNotice: This profile contains partial data: some collection items failed, so conclusions may be incomplete.

my.title: My jobs
my.subtitle: Sign in to find all your ability profiles again — closing the browser won't lose them.
my.gateTitle: Sign in to see your profiles
my.gateBody: Sign in with GitHub to see every ability profile you have analyzed.
my.empty: You haven't analyzed any profile yet — go generate one.
my.jobsHint: Jobs are drained by a scheduled poll and may stay queued for hours; the report link appears here once one is ready.
my.outcomesHint: {count} submitted application(s) have no real result recorded yet. Only you can record it — without it there is no data for any outcome-driven retrospective or adjustment.
interviews.applicationPlaceholder: No applications ready to advance yet. You can still fill in the role manually.
interviews.noProfile: You don't have a profile yet. Generate one first to manage interviews.
my.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes its evidence, applications and interviews; share links stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
my.deleteError: Deletion failed. Please try again later.
my.deleteHint: Delete a profile you claimed together with all related data (self-service unlink)
workbench.title: Job workbench
workbench.subtitle: The agent scans the job pool daily against your job preferences and prepares an explainable match report plus a targeted resume and cover letter; you decide what to submit.
workbench.error: Failed to load the job workbench
workbench.gateTitle: Sign in to use the job workbench
workbench.gateBody: Job preferences, job runs and the pending approval list are private to your account. Sign in with GitHub to start.
workbench.noProfileHint: You have no ability profile yet — analyze one first, then create a job run.
workbench.preferences.title: My job preferences
workbench.preferences.hint: Preferences decide what the agent looks for: target titles are hard filters, skills feed the weighted score, and an empty skill list falls back to your profile skills.
workbench.preferences.empty: No job preferences yet — create your first set.
workbench.preferences.titlesPlaceholder: Comma separated, e.g. backend engineer, platform engineer
workbench.preferences.skillsPlaceholder: Comma separated; empty uses your profile skills
workbench.preferences.required: Please fill in a preference name and at least one target job title.
workbench.runs.title: Job runs
workbench.runs.hint: One preference plus one profile equals one job run; every status transition is recorded in the event timeline below and can be replayed.
workbench.runs.empty: No job runs yet — pick a preference and a profile, then create one.
workbench.runs.selectHint: Select a run to see its event timeline and pending approvals.
workbench.runs.scanResult: This scan: {candidates} candidates, {intentsCreated} new intents (pool size {poolSize})
workbench.pending.title: Pending approvals
workbench.pending.hint: The agent only prepares — after approving, submit on the job page yourself and come back to mark it submitted.
workbench.pending.empty: No jobs waiting for your approval.
workbench.pending.approved: Approved {count} job(s). Please submit them on the job pages yourself.
workbench.submissions.title: Submissions and outcomes
workbench.submissions.hint: Record what actually happened after you applied — this is the only source of retrospective samples, and without it no outcome-driven adjustment is possible.
workbench.match.title: Match report
workbench.match.gap.tagNotInProfile: The job asks for "{tag}", which has no record in your profile yet
workbench.match.boost.addEvidenceForTag: Add one traceable evidence item for "{skill}" to raise the match for this job
workbench.errors.code.preferenceNotFound: This job preference no longer exists. Please refresh and try again.
workbench.errors.code.runNotFound: This job run no longer exists. Please refresh and try again.
workbench.errors.code.intentNotFound: This pending job no longer exists. Please refresh and try again.
workbench.errors.code.profileNotOwned: The selected profile is not claimed by you. Claim it on the My jobs page first.
workbench.errors.code.runNotActive: This job run was cancelled or archived and cannot continue.
workbench.errors.code.invalidTransition: The current status does not accept this action. Please refresh and try again.
workbench.errors.code.nothingToApprove: There is nothing to approve (everything may already be handled).
workbench.errors.code.dailyLimitReached: The daily submit limit for this source has been reached. Please try again tomorrow.
workbench.errors.code.artifactsUnavailab: Failed to generate the resume or cover letter: the profile or job does not carry enough information.

extensionAuth.title: Browser extension access
extensionAuth.subtitle: Let the browser extension act as your signed-in identity (analyze, workbench, application tracking).
extensionAuth.hint: A code is valid for 5 minutes and can be consumed once; tokens can be revoked anytime and take effect immediately.
extensionAuth.issuedTitle: Paste this code into the extension
extensionAuth.issuedBody: The extension exchanges it for a long-lived token; the code is shown only once.
extensionAuth.revokeConfirm: The extension will immediately lose access to your data. Revoke?
extensionAuth.loadFailed: Failed to load extension access list
extensionAuth.issueFailed: Failed to issue a code, please retry
extensionAuth.notLoggedIn: Not signed in or session expired
